Name: Guild Kill List
Author: yadm18
Description:
[heading]The list, from your inventory[/heading]

After you reach floor 100 of the Mines, Marlon sends a letter and asks you to visit the Adventurer's Guild. On that visit he walks over to meet you, then tells you the monster eradication list is in your pack.

From then on, a button on the inventory screen opens the same list as the board on the guild wall.

[heading]How you get it[/heading]

[list]
[*]You can already enter the Adventurer's Guild, the way you normally would.[/*]
[*]You have reached floor 100 of the Mines. The Skull Cavern does not count. A save that already reached the floor still qualifies, including while the Mines are dangerous.[/*]
[*]Marlon's letter is in the mailbox the same day. Read it.[/*]
[*]Go to the guild. If another scene is already playing, his visit waits for another trip.[/*]
[*]You and Marlon walk toward each other. He tells you to open your inventory and check the list from anywhere.[/*]
[*]The button is there after that conversation. Skipping the scene still counts.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]The button[/heading]

The tooltip is "Monster Eradication Goals". Clicking it opens the guild's monster eradication list. It does not cover the item grid, and it is not an item. A tooltip from an item in the bag draws over the sword.

[heading]Install Easy Access Buttons with this mod[/heading]

This version adds the sword to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url]. Install that mod with this one. The sword joins its column and lines up with the Community Center button, Organize, and the other mods that want the same inventory spot. Reorder or hide it from the gear menu there. That shared column is what this version is made for.

[line]
[size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53328]Easy Access Buttons[/url][/b][/size]
by Yadm

One column for the inventory buttons that would otherwise cover each other. Guild Kill List joins that column on its own.
[line]

Without Easy Access Buttons, the sword stays in its old spot under Organize. Other mods that want that same spot can cover it there.

[heading]Options[/heading]

With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, the toggle is "Show the guild list in inventory". It starts on. Without that mod, the button still appears once Marlon has given it to you.

[heading]Notes[/heading]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/*]
[*]Install Easy Access Buttons with this mod. Guild Kill List still loads on its own, and the sword then keeps its old spot.[/*]
[*]Works alongside [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. Marlon in that guild is used for the visit.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]Install[/heading]

[list]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install with Vortex, or unzip the folder into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]You should have Mods/GuildKillList/manifest.json.[/*]
[*]Install Easy Access Buttons the same way.[/*]
[/list]
